evals.prompt: ini video tutorial gua 60 detik, gua nunjukin cara pake Claude buat nulis. udah ada subtitle nempel dari capcut. bikin kayak referensi tutorial kemarin: layar di atas, muka gua di bawah, kotak biru buat klaim penting, kotak merah buat nunjuk tombol. screenshot ada di assets/
evals.expected_output: split-mode image beats filling the top panel with camera pans, layout.splitFocus calibrated to the face, captions enabled with when:'split' (burned-in subs get cropped), callout blue boxes and annotate boxes with boil:false, a hook title with upper:true, a leak transition at the first face→screen cut; stills checked before render

evals.prompt: di detik 14-18 gua ngomong 'three in one, five in one, seven in one'. bikin jadi tipografi kata per kata kayak referensi maroon kemarin, terus di bagian gua nyebut layanan-layanan kasih coretan merah yang ganti-ganti kata

evals.prompt: ini video founder gua 2 menit, subtitle udah nempel. tambahin motion, decide sendiri tiap part pake style apa jun, jangan monoton, dan awalnya harus langsung nahan orang biar gak scroll
evals.expected_output: plan table with a style column (S0–S3 mixed, ≥ 3 styles, no two consecutive graphic parts in the same style unless one idea), a designed visual in the first 0.5 s, key message on screen by 3 s, ≥ 3 visual events in the first 10 s, no 5-second bucket without a visual event; locked jundy palette as base with at most 1–2 parts in a library palette; the agent does not ask the user to pick styles or colours

evals.prompt: video talking head gua 70 detik (raw landscape 16:9) soal 'cara bikin sistem konten 30 hari'. gua mau kayak referensi papan tulis: wajah gua kecil di bawah, di atas kertas grid ada kalender 30 hari, mind map topik, nomor bab 1 dan 2 di garis lengkung. subtitle satu kata per kotak abu. satu bagian jelasin 'sistem dibangun dari potongan kecil' pakai diagram isometrik. jangan ganti gaya lama, gabungin aja.
evals.expected_output: layout.pip bottom + captions style word; board parts with palette graph + backdrop grid (calendar, mindmap, chapter style arc) in insert mode; one iso part (palette frost, <= 14 s) in the full-screen budget; the plan table mixes S5 with earlier styles (no two consecutive parts in the same style) and keeps >= 30 % clean footage; stills checked before render; and for a PORTRAIT raw video the plan must not use layout.pip bottom (split or the default window instead), and no key word is placed behind the speaker
